title: [Accommodation Request API - POST /api/traveler/request-bids] 200 OK Room-Request Response Serializes Sensitive User Columns in data.customerRequest.user
environment: Staging (STAG) · Strapi Backend API & Desktop 1440×900 · Chrome · en-US · FE=turbopack-2h-u0he6dowwt, BE=<CHECK_DEPLOYED_SHA> (https://web.stag.goodnstay.com/en-US/accommodation)
test_account: Signed-In QA Traveler Session on Staging (Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED_QA_TOKEN>)
steps_to_reproduce: Prepare the complete valid room-request baseline fixture (fixtures/valid-request-bids.json) using sanitized QA data (QA Tester, qa-sample@example.test, +84900000000, KR / KR-11, guestCount=2, roomCount=1).
Inspect the HTTP 200 OK JSON response body keys inside data.customerRequest.user.
Execute GET https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/customer-requests readback to confirm saved record #1536, then cancel test record #1536.
actual_result:
- POST /api/traveler/request-bids returns HTTP 200 OK creating Customer Request #1536, and embeds the unredacted Strapi up_users entity inside data.customerRequest.user containing sensitive internal columns:
  • data.customerRequest.user.password ("<REDACTED_HASH>")
  • data.customerRequest.user.resetPasswordToken
  • data.customerRequest.user.confirmationToken
expected_result:
- Per API Standard (Confluence 524593) and DTO Response Sanitization rules, 2xx room-request creation responses must return only public receipt fields and must never serialize internal credential/token columns (password, resetPasswordToken, confirmationToken) over the network.
- Customer Request record is persisted and verified via GET /api/customer-requests readback.

evidence.console: Test Case STAG-API-203 (Positive DTO Sanitization) | Single-Variable Delta: None — valid baseline fixture | Test record #1536 cancelled after readback.
evidence.network: POST https://services.stag.goodnstay.com/api/traveler/request-bids (fixtures/valid-request-bids.json) -> HTTP 200 OK exposing data.customerRequest.user.{password, resetPasswordToken, confirmationToken}.
evidence.notes: Frontend chunk 452btq2-mvhin.js calls POST /api/traveler/request-bids. Strapi custom controller populates and returns the full up_users relation without applying sanitizeOutput / explicit DTO field selection. | Security Classification: OWASP A04:2025 Cryptographic Failures & A01:2025 (CWE-201) · OWASP API3:2023 Broken Object Property Level Authorization (Excessive Data Exposure) | OWASP Remediation: Apply explicit DTO response allow-listing or Strapi contentAPI.sanitize.output before returning customerRequest payloads (https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/REST_Security_Cheat_Sheet.html).

classification: Confirmed Bug — POST /api/traveler/request-bids 200 OK Response Serializes Internal up_users Credential Columns
reproducibility: Always (100% — reproduced on every valid room-request submission on STAG)
